summary: Lincoln Educational Services Corp via its subsidiary Lincoln Technical Institute entered into a purchase and sale agreement to buy real property in Melrose Park, IL for $18.8M, which it currently leases. The filing is an 8-K Item 1.01 disclosing a material definitive agreement for a real estate purchase, not a special situation transaction. Terms include customary conditions and due diligence, with closing expected June 25, 2026. This is a routine lease buyout and property acquisition, not a merger, tender, or other special situation. No board recommendation or advisors are named; the registrant is the buyer. No risk arbitrage angle applies.
